comment: CoreCLR's PAL suite on WitOS (plan step R7.1): the tests of upstream's paltestlist.txt that runtime-witos leaves out, each with the reason, which @Docs/Implementation/R7.1-PAL-Suite.md explains. Every other test of the list runs in the guest and must pass.

excluded.file_io/GetFullPathNameA/test3/paltest_g: creates a directory: /dev/shm holds files alone until the namespace service (D5)
excluded.file_io/GetFullPathNameA/test4/paltest_g: creates a directory: /dev/shm holds files alone until the namespace service (D5)

excluded.file_io/SearchPathW/test1/paltest_search: writes a file outside its working directory (/tmp, /var/tmp): /dev/shm is the one directory in which a process creates files until the namespace service (D5)
excluded.file_io/WriteFile/test1/paltest_writefil: makes a file read-only with chmod: the files of /dev/shm keep the mode they were created with
excluded.filemapping_memmgt/MapViewOfFile/test1/p: writes a file outside its working directory (/tmp, /var/tmp): /dev/shm is the one directory in which a process creates files until the namespace service (D5)
excluded.filemapping_memmgt/ProbeMemory/ProbeMemo: a pipe within the process copies in user space: an inaccessible buffer faults where Linux returns EFAULT; PAL_ProbeMemory serves the debugger alone
